comment: The input rules of the panel API and the agent. The generator agent/cmd/cf-rules writes the Go checks (agent/internal/validate/rules_gen.go) and the PHP rules (api/app/Validation/InputRules.php) from this file. Refer to schema/README.md.

unixUser.doc: The Unix user of a website, for example "acme_x7k2".
unixUser.message: Use a name such as acme_x7k2: a letter, at most 15 letters or digits, an underscore, and 4 letters or digits.

domain.doc: A domain name in lower case. Each label has 1 to 63 characters. The last label is not a number, so that the name is not an IP address (audit finding R5).
domain.message: Enter a domain name in lower-case letters, for example shop.example.com.

id.message: Enter an ID of 26 letters and digits.

databaseName.doc: The full name of a database or a database user.
databaseName.message: Use 2 to 63 lower-case letters, digits and underscores. Start with a letter.

databaseNameSuffix.doc: The part of a database name that the user types. The panel puts the Unix user of the website and an underscore before it (CF-01).
databaseNameSuffix.message: Use 1 to 32 lower-case letters, digits and underscores. Start with a letter or a digit.

imageReference.doc: An image reference with no tag. It starts with the host name of a registry: a name with a dot or a port, or "localhost". Podman would search a short name such as "nginx" in its default registries (audit finding R5).
imageReference.message: Enter an image reference with its registry and no tag, for example ghcr.io/team/app.

imageTag.message: Use 1 to 128 letters, digits, underscores, dots and hyphens. Do not start with a dot or a hyphen.

image.doc: An image reference with a tag: the rules imageReference and imageTag with ":" between them.
image.message: Enter an image reference with its registry and a tag, for example ghcr.io/team/app:1.2.

digest.doc: The digest of an image. An empty digest is permitted.
digest.message: Enter a digest: sha256: and 64 hexadecimal digits in lower case.

phpExtension.doc: The name of a PHP extension.
phpExtension.message: Use 1 to 40 lower-case letters, digits and underscores.

iniKey.doc: The name of a php.ini setting.
iniKey.message: Use 1 to 64 lower-case letters, underscores and dots.

iniValue.doc: A php.ini value. It is on one line and has no double quotes.
iniValue.message: Use at most 200 characters on one line, with no double quotes.

sha256.doc: A SHA-256 hash in lower-case hexadecimal.
sha256.message: Enter 64 hexadecimal digits in lower case.

restorePath.doc: The path of a file or a directory in a website. It starts with "/". It has no empty part, no "." part, no ".." part and no "/" at the end.
restorePath.message: Enter a path that starts with /, for example /public/index.php. Do not use "//", "." or ".." parts, or a / at the end.

documentRoot.doc: A directory in /app, for example "public" or "web/htdocs". "." is /app. It has at most 8 parts. A part does not start with a dot. An empty value is permitted: the agent then uses the default of the image.
documentRoot.message: Enter a directory in /app, for example public or web/htdocs. Use letters, digits, dots, underscores and hyphens, and at most 8 parts.

commandArgument.doc: One argument of the start command of a custom image. It has no control characters.
commandArgument.message: Each argument must have 1 to 1024 characters and no control characters.

sshKey.doc: One public key in the format of authorized_keys, with no options.
sshKey.message: Enter one public SSH key on one line, for example: ssh-ed25519 AAAA... name. Do not put options before the key.

reservedDatabaseNames.doc: Names that the shared database servers use (CF-01).

reservedDatabasePrefixes.doc: A database name does not start with one of these (CF-01).

commandArguments.doc: The largest number of arguments of a start command.
